exposure: mode of delivery (vaginal delivery/caesarean delivery/assisted breach delivery)
cohort: The study included 90 women who experienced postpartum haemorrhage, selected from a larger group of 700 pregnant women.
finding: The study found that among 90 PPH cases, 63.3% were multigravida, 63.1% were haemodynamically stable, 40% had caesarean delivery, and 6.6% were associated with macrosomia.
mod_finding: Among the PPH cases, 40% had caesarean delivery, 23.3% had vaginal delivery, and 6.4% had assisted breach delivery.
birth_weight: Macrosomia was noted in 6.6% of PPH cases, but a specific weight range for the overall cohort was not mentioned.
